item.name: Authentication

request.description:
Endpoint: POST /api/auth/register
Method: POST
Description: Register a new user and send OTP for verification.

🔸 Request Attributes
| Name | Data Type | Length | Mandatory | Description |
|------|-----------|--------|-----------|-------------|
| email | String | 100 | Yes | Email address |
| password | String | 8- | Yes | Password (min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit, special char) |
| confirmPassword | String | - | Yes | Password confirmation |

🔹 Response Attributes
| Name | Data Type | Length | Mandatory | Description |
|------|-----------|--------|-----------|-------------|
| message | String | 255 | Yes | Success message (OTP sent) |

⚠️ Possible Errors
| HTTP Code | Error Code | Message | Description |
|-----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| 400 | VALIDATION_ERROR | Request tidak valid | Invalid email format or password constraints |
| 409 | USER_EMAIL_ALREADY_EXISTS | Email sudah terdaftar | Email address already registered |
| 500 | INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR | Terjadi kesalahan pada server | Internal server error |

Additional Notes:
- Sends OTP code to user's email for account verification
- Password must contain at least one uppercase letter, lowercase letter, digit, and special character

Endpoint: POST /api/auth/verify-otp
Method: POST
Description: Verify OTP code sent to user's email.

🔸 Request Attributes
| Name | Data Type | Length | Mandatory | Description |
|------|-----------|--------|-----------|-------------|
| userId | String | - | Yes | User ID from registration |
| otpCode | String | 6 | Yes | 6-digit OTP code |

🔹 Response Attributes
| Name | Data Type | Length | Mandatory | Description |
|------|-----------|--------|-----------|-------------|
| message | String | 255 | Yes | Success message (verified successfully) |

⚠️ Possible Errors
| HTTP Code | Error Code | Message | Description |
|-----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| 400 | VALIDATION_ERROR | Request tidak valid | Invalid OTP format |
| 401 | INVALID_OTP | Invalid OTP | OTP code is incorrect or expired |
| 404 | USER_NOT_FOUND | User not found | User ID does not exist |
| 500 | INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR | Terjadi kesalahan pada server | Internal server error |

Additional Notes:
- OTP is valid for a limited time (typically 5-10 minutes)
- After successful verification, user can proceed to login

Endpoint: POST /api/auth/login
Method: POST
Description: Authenticate user and obtain JWT token.

🔸 Request Attributes
| Name | Data Type | Length | Mandatory | Description |
|------|-----------|--------|-----------|-------------|
| email | String | 100 | Yes | Email address |
| password | String | - | Yes | Password |

🔹 Response Attributes
| Name | Data Type | Length | Mandatory | Description |
|------|-----------|--------|-----------|-------------|
| userId | Long | - | Yes | User ID |
| fullName | String | 100 | Yes | User's full name |
| email | String | 100 | Yes | Email address |
| token | String | 512 | Yes | JWT access token |
| role | String | - | Yes | User role (HOMEOWNER/CONSULTANT) |
| status | String | - | Yes | Account status |
| expiresIn | Integer | - | Yes | Token expiration time in seconds |

⚠️ Possible Errors
| HTTP Code | Error Code | Message | Description |
|-----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| 400 | VALIDATION_ERROR | Request tidak valid | Invalid email format |
| 401 | INVALID_CREDENTIALS | Email atau password salah | Invalid email or password |
| 401 | ACCOUNT_INACTIVE | Akun tidak aktif | Account is not active |
| 500 | INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR | Terjadi kesalahan pada server | Internal server error |

Additional Notes:
- Returns JWT token for subsequent authenticated requests
- Token should be included in Authorization header as 'Bearer {token}'
